main.description: Metadata record providing additional context or data on an existing published astronomical transient.

description.description: Optional additional context about provided metadata. This field can be up to 2000 characters, but try to keep this concise.

eventRef.description: Strong reference to the event that this metadata relates to.

data.description: Arbitrary JSON object containing provided metadata or measurements about an event. Currently schema-free, but try to keep these entries self-consistent with your own work, while also using common property names (such as 'ra' or 'dec'.)

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this metadata was originally created.
